text_block_list.text:
It's summer—time for Umamusume to
tackle new challenges at the
balmy
beachside training camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Onward... to beauty!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Splish, splash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hah! Brilliantly now!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Splash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O seems to be enjoying herself
frolicking in the water, though
I'm clueless
as to what kind of regimen this is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Well, Тренер? Were you inspired by the whimsy of my water training?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You showed a lot of spirit.

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Excellent observation, as
always. The theme for this
performance
was "freeing the inner me."
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Strong muscles aren't the only thing to be
gained in the sea. There's
also an inner
strength to be had by freely expressing
one's true self.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My rippling of the water is at times serene,
and at times turbulent.
What you'll witness
now would make a mermaid turn green
with envy!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I heard about her. She's really...
something, isn't she? I know it's
fun to
splash around in the water, but still...
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, hehe... Yeeeah, for someone like
Opera O, it makes sense.
Even when she's
racing, she's really, um, at ease?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
No matter what the people around us say,
Opera O continues with
single-minded
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now a wide turn here! Skim the sand like
so... and flutter like a
butterfly!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: The white clouds, the blue sea, the roaring waves, and the beauteous me! This summer will only happen once, so I must use every ounce of my being!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now I'm even less sure what she's doing,
but she's doing it with gusto.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O is pursuing her goal without
hesitation, so her trainer can't
just sit back
and watch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's make this the best training camp ever!

text_block_list.text:
Well said! My training shall be ceaseless as
the tides! My harmony
with the vast ocean
will make the beach itself sing!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
After our long day of training, I'm back at
the dorms taking a
much-needed break.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Well, I come bearing an important matter
to discuss.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But first, I'd like to adjust what time we
start tomorrow. What say you
to 4 a.m.?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Early, you say... Ah, you're right! Summer it
may be, but the sun is yet
to rise at that
hour.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We'd need more sunlight for a proper
backdrop during my
performance. I
agree—better to wait until a little later to
start.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Then, once we've begun, I will enter
the water slowly, whilst
pushing back my
hair in a dramatic fashion.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Like a fish nestled amongst sea anemones,
I'll sway and synchronize
with the waves in
an elegant dance.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
Some anemones are poisonous, so let's watch
out for those...

text_block_list.text:
Really? You don't say. Then I'll be sure to
keep my limbs from
becoming too
acquainted with them.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And after a dramatic pause, I'll burst forth
from the sea, singing as the
salty droplets
fall around me! Even the sirens of
midsummer will fall in
love with my voice!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Just like a post-race concert, we must
always top things off with a
heart-rousing
song.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The beachgoers will be moved to tears as
they celebrate me with
thunderous
applause. Ah, it shall be perfect!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! I'm filled with excitement
for tomorrow! Until we
meet again on the
training field!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Didn't you want to ask me about something?

text_block_list.text: Ah, that. It's all cleared up now.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I had several concerns related to my
training, about whether I should
really
continue down my own path or not.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But speaking to you just now, I was
reminded that you, at least, offer
candid
thoughts of concern—not denial.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Your direction is to the point—never
dismissive or given with your
eyes glazed
over.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I knew I'd made the right decision. So I
have no more need to confirm
and can
proceed without fear.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You were thinking about all that?

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what? Even I have times when I
question my own
actions—whether they're
correct or not.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But I could never let anyone see such
doubt in my eyes. I'm the
Umamusume who
will become the Centurial Overlord after
all.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heh, as a true sovereign should be.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Well, I must start preparing for tomorrow. I
wouldn't want my
audience to be
disappointed.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, that's right. There was one more
thing.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If I were to ever again want to recite my
thoughts on the future... may
I count on
you to lend your ear?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha! I really am amazing to
find such a fine trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's another wonderful day, and Opera O is
doing her own thing for
training again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look, the rising sun blesses my coming
once again. I'll waste not a
second and get
right to work!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
First I'll let my hair flow in the fresh sea air.
A brush of the hand
through it, and then a
flash of a wink to my adoring fans...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha ha! I am so gorgeous this day!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That Opera O's looking, er, dreamy as
ever.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, for real. I'm kinda jealous though. I
wish I had that kind of
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Heh, there's not a single other
Umamusume on this beach who can
equal
my radiance! Wouldn't you agree, my fine
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're the best, Opera O!

text_block_list.text: Well said! For I am to be the Centurial Overlord—she who will bathe the world in her stunning light!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О is exploding with
confidence. For her though, that's
just like
any other day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
